upstream_prs.title: [Kernel] Consolidate Marlin thread-tile padding across all dense Marlin paths
upstream_prs.taken: only its modelopt.py line: ModelOptFp8LinearMethod.create_weights sets layer.orig_dtype, which prepare_fp8_layer_for_marlin reads. The tile-padding part is not needed because every A.X-K2 per-rank GEMM shape at TP8 is already Marlin-aligned (N % 64 == 0, K % 128 == 0).

applied_on: SKT-AI/vllm axk2-v0.23.0 @ 023bc76025459d6356c5885f271b9b95c50f93b6 (its modelopt.py is byte-identical to upstream v0.23.0)
note: Opt-in (NVFP4_SM80_PORT=1). Lets the official skt/A.X-K2-NVFP4 checkpoint (modelopt MIXED_PRECISION: NVFP4 routed experts, FP8 per-tensor attention/shared-expert/dense layers, BF16 embeddings/LM head) load on A100. SM80 has no FP4/FP8 tensor cores, so vLLM selects Marlin for both: routed experts run W4A16 (FP4 weights dequantized inside the kernel, BF16 activations) and FP8 layers run W8A16 (MarlinFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel). Blackwell runs the same checkpoint W4A4/W8A8 on FP4/FP8 tensor cores. Kernel selection on SM89+ is unchanged. Diff context is 8 lines because the 3-line context of the capability hunk also matches ModelOptFp8Config.

vllm/model_executor/layers/quantization/.diff:

+++ b/vllm/model_executor/layers/quantization/modelopt.py
@@ -463,16 +463,17 @@ class ModelOptFp8LinearMethod(LinearMethodBase):
         **extra_weight_attrs,
     ):
         del input_size, output_size
         output_size_per_partition = sum(output_partition_sizes)
         weight_loader = extra_weight_attrs.get("weight_loader")
         layer.logical_widths = output_partition_sizes
         layer.input_size_per_partition = input_size_per_partition
         layer.output_size_per_partition = output_size_per_partition
+        layer.orig_dtype = params_dtype
         weight_dtype = (
             torch.float8_e4m3fn
             if self.quant_config.is_checkpoint_fp8_serialized
             else params_dtype
         )
         weight = ModelWeightParameter(
             data=torch.empty(
                 output_size_per_partition, input_size_per_partition, dtype=weight_dtype
@@ -2212,17 +2213,23 @@ class ModelOptMixedPrecisionConfig(ModelOptQuantConfigBase):
     def get_name(self) -> QuantizationMethods:
         return "modelopt_mixed"
 
     def get_supported_act_dtypes(self) -> list[torch.dtype]:
         return [torch.bfloat16, torch.half]
 
     @classmethod
     def get_min_capability(cls) -> int:
-        return 89
+        # Ampere (SM80/SM86): NVFP4 routed experts run via Marlin W4A16, and FP8
+        # weight-only dense layers run via MarlinFP8 (W8A16, compute in
+        # bf16/fp16). FP8 MoE, if present, also routes to Marlin because
+        # TritonExperts gates its FP8 schemes behind supports_fp8() (cc>=89).
+        # None of these paths require native FP8 tensor cores, so SM80 is
+        # sufficient.
+        return 80
 
     @classmethod
     def override_quantization_method(
         cls, hf_quant_cfg, user_quant, hf_config=None
     ) -> QuantizationMethods | None:
         algo = cls._extract_modelopt_quant_algo(hf_quant_cfg)
         if algo is not None and algo == "MIXED_PRECISION":
             return "modelopt_mixed"
